name: Virginia-creeper
desc: Virginia-creeper (Parthenocissus quinquefolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Parthenocissus quinquefolia, commonly known as Virginia creeper, woodbine, five-leaved ivy, or five-finger, is a species of flowering vine in the grape family Vitaceae.
